title: A joke domain purchase turned in geopolitical warfare
summary: This article describes how a casual domain purchase for SondeHub, a radiosonde weather balloon tracking project, unexpectedly escalated into a geopolitical incident when Russian hackers or state actors targeted the infrastructure, turning a hobbyist technical project into a cyberwarfare battleground.
problem_solved: Tracks and maps weather balloons (radiosondes) globally through community-driven receivers
why_valuable: Demonstrates how open-source hobbyist projects can inadvertently become targets in geopolitical conflicts, highlighting the expanding attack surface of civilian technical infrastructure
